name: Plank
steps: Kneel on a mat and place your forearms on the floor, elbows directly under your shoulders.
Step your feet back one at a time until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Tuck your hips slightly and brace your stomach as if about to be poked.
Hold the position without letting your hips sag or rise.
Lower your knees to the mat to finish.
cues: Head to heels in one straight line
Look at the floor, neck long

common_mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes and tuck hips slightly; drop to knees if needed

common_mistakes.mistake: Hips piked high in the air
common_mistakes.fix: Lower hips until shoulders, hips and heels line up
Take short, steady breaths through the whole hold
